notes: Cliopatria has no Mutapa. Budget: one article opened, with three further passes over the same cached page. The page gives no start year (infobox: 'Established: 15th century'; Beach and Pikirayi: 14th-15th century), so 1430 is a bridge at confidence 1 and Matope's and Mukombero's conquests are placed by bridge years (1450, 1470) at confidence 1. The end is 1885 (Chidima annexed, Dzuda in exile); the infobox says 'Conquered by the Portuguese: 1884' and the resistance of Chioko Dambamupute (1897-1902) falls after the end year and is recorded only as a war in the Portuguese Mozambique dossier (counterpart mutapa-empire). The 1890 British ultimatum 'led to the partition of Mutapa's former territories' between Britain and Portugal: the plateau side was Rozvi and then Ndebele ground by then, so no Mutapa loss to Britain is entered. Counterparts needing dossiers: kingdom-of-barue (Barue), manyika-kingdom (Manyika), and 'dande' (a principality of c. 1760), plus the Teve/Kiteve kingdom. The 1629 vassalage is entered from the Mutapa side as the loss of the Tete territory; the vassal tint itself belongs on the portuguese-mozambique ledger (vassal_start 1629 / vassal_end 1678, counterpart mutapa-empire). Capital coordinates are stand-ins (Mashonaland Central; Tete). Gazetteer: names resolve (region Mashonaland; admin1 Tete, Manica, Manicaland, Zambezia, Sofala; river Zambezi). REPAIR 2026-10-19 (after review): (1) The 1632 loss of the lower Zambezi valley to portuguese-mozambique is deleted: the Mutapa page says only 'a Portuguese captain led an army to subdue the Valley from Quelimane to Sena' and does not put the valley under Mutapa; its one hint is that 'the Tonga of the Lower Zambezi had been in rebellion against Mutapa since c. 1550', and its 'Matope gained control over trade routes along the Zambezi', 'traditions vary on whether Matope extended his rule to the Indian Ocean'. No keyframe draws the valley. portuguese-mozambique /ledger/6 now takes the valley from 'nobody'. (2) K1 is split at 1470 (mutapa-empire_1450 for 1450-1469 without Manica and Manicaland; mutapa-empire_1470 for 1470-1606). (3) The Chidima capital is a stand-in inside the shape (Luangwa), not Tete town. (4) Thin items tried: Nyatsimba Mutota (no founding year; reign 1420-1450), Kingdom of Barue (1608; nothing on Mukombwe's suzerainty or its end); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyanhehwe_Matope did not load (URL_NOT_FOUND) and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uteve did not load either (URL_NOT_FOUND); the Matope, Mukombero and 1692 years remain bridges at confidence 1.
